A little something from my heart

Mister Handsome,

♡ ───── ♥ ───── ♡

Hello, Hello Mister Husband 🤭💞

Actually, you are the love of my life, and you mean more to me than I can ever explain. 🫠 Mujy nahi pata kab aur kaisay ap meri zindagi ka itna important hissa ban gaye ke ab khud ko ap ke baghair imagine karna bhi mere liye really harsh hai.

I never, ever want to lose you, and I never want to keep any distance between us. 🥺❤️

Honestly, mujy ap se pehle kabhi yaqeen nahi aata tha ke koi kisi se itna pure aur genuine pyaar kar sakta hai. Mujy lagta tha log bas ye sab baatein apne dil ko behlanay ke liye karte hain... lekin ap se milne ke baad mujy samajh aya ke purity kya hoti hai, genuine love kya hota hai, aur masoom larkay bhi hotay hain. 😊🌸

Hamza, shayad main ap ke itni close na hoti, shayad itni attached bhi na hoti... lekin yaar, ap ne khud mujhy itna pyaar feel karwaya, itna special feel karwaya, ke ab dil naturally ap ki taraf khinchta chala jata hai. 🫠💞

Ap ne mujhy ye feel karwaya ke mujhy bhi koi toot kar chah sakta hai, meri fikar kar sakta hai, mujhy apni duniya ka itna important hissa samajh sakta hai. Aur shayad isi liye ab ap meri sochon ka woh hissa ban gaye hain jo 24 hours kahin na kahin mere mind mein rehta hai. 🌸🥹

So, Mister Handsome... 💌
I LOVE YOU SOOOO MUCHHHH 💛

And no matter how many times I say it, it will never feel enough to explain how much you mean to me. 🥺❤️

You are my Mister Handsome, my Husband, my favourite person, and my very special one. 🤭💞

You are mine 🥰
& always, always you are mine. 🤗💛

Bas hamesha aise hi mera haath pakar kar, mere qareeb rehna... aur hamara ye beautiful sa bond hamesha aise hi bana rehna. 🫶🏻🌸

Happy Birthday, Mister Handsome. 💌🎂

I love you more than words can ever explain. ❤️

Forever yours... 💞
